    if(kernel == "gaussian") { return std::exp(-(r*r)); }
    return std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
}

double RecS(double xB, double y, double z, double pT, double phi_h) {
    if((!std::isfinite(xB)) || (!std::isfinite(y)) || (!std::isfinite(z)) || (!std::isfinite(pT)) || (!std::isfinite(phi_h))) { return 1.0; }
    const double phi_rad = phi_h * 3.14159265358979323846 / 180.0;
    double pt[6];
    pt[0] = xB; pt[1] = y; pt[2] = z; pt[3] = pT; pt[4] = std::cos(phi_rad); pt[5] = std::sin(phi_rad);
    const int ndim = RecS_ndim;
    const int P = RecS_n;
    const int R = RecS_n_poly;
    const double eps = RecS_epsilon;
    double sum = 0.0;
    double residual = 0.0;
    for(int i = 0; i < P; ++i) {
        double r2 = 0.0;
        for(int j = 0; j < ndim; ++j) {
            const double diff = eps * pt[j] - eps * RecS_centers[i][j];
            r2 += diff * diff;
        }
        const double k = RecS_scipy_rbf_kernel(std::sqrt(r2), RecS_kernel);
        sum += RecS_coeffs[i] * k;
        residual += RecS_residual_coeffs[i] * k;
    }
    double xhat[6];
    for(int j = 0; j < ndim; ++j) {
        xhat[j] = (pt[j] - RecS_shift[j]) / RecS_scale[j];
    }
    for(int m = 0; m < R; ++m) {
        double mono = 1.0;
        for(int j = 0; j < ndim; ++j) {
            const int powv = RecS_powers[m][j];
            if(powv != 0) { mono *= std::pow(xhat[j], powv); }
        }
        sum += RecS_coeffs[P + m] * mono;
        residual += RecS_residual_coeffs[P + m] * mono;
    }
    return sum * residual;
}
